content: Kamwomwmwomwlahn Mohap
Iet me KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, mahsanih duwen Mohap:

content.text: eh kelen mahwen kehlail kan rengkdier,
oh wiewia koasoandi suwed en kamwomwala wehin Mohap.
kumwail rong ngilen seri kan ar wie sengiseng.
Kumwail rong ngilen ar makiaki kan
Kumwail tang duwehte ahs en wel kan!’
“Mohap, ke kin koapworopworki omw kehlail oh reken kepwe,
ahpw met ke pil pahn lohdier;
iangahki nah soupeidi oh samworo kan.
Sohte kahnimw ehu pahn pitsang kamwomwmwomwlao;
wahu oh sahpw patapat koaros pahn ohla.
Kumwail kauwada en Mohap ehu kilel en eh sousou;
oh sohla me pahn pwurehng kousoan wasao.”

content: (En riahla aramas me sohte kapwaiada sapwellimen KAUN-O doadoahk ni mohngiong unsek! En riahla aramas me sohte kamwakid kedlahs oh kemehla aramas!)
Kahnimw kan en Mohap Mwomwlahr

KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Sang mahs Mohap kin saledek sang apwal oh sohte mwahn kin kalipilipala. Mohap rasehng wain me kin mihmi nan sah ehu oh sohte kin wudekiong nan ehu sah tohrohr. Nemeneme sohte mwahn kin ohla, oh kin iou ahnsou koaros.
“Eri met, ahnsowo leledohr me I pahn kadarodo aramas akan pwehn wudekihla Mohap rasehng wain. Re pahn wudekihsang kanengen sahn wain kan oh kauwehla sah kan.
Mehn Mohap ahpw pahn sohla koapworopworki ar koht Kemos, duwehte mehn Israel ar sohla koapworopworki Pedel, koht me re likihala.

content.text: “Ohlen Mohap kan, dahme kumwail kosekosehki me dene kumwail sounpei ndand kei,
Mohap oh eh kahnimw kan mwomwlahr;
nah mwahnakapw me keieu kaselel kan kamakamalahr.
Ngehi me nanmwarki, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap,
eh pahn ohla pahn mwadang leledo.
kumwail koaros me ese duwen eh ndand.
Kumwail patohwan, ‘Eh manaman en kaunda wasa ohlahr;
kumwail doudihsang nan deumwail waun kan
oh karangkedier eh kelen mahwen kan.
kumwail kesihnenda limwahn ahl akan oh awiawih;
kumwail idek rehn me tangatang kohwei kan,

content: “Kadeik leledohngehr kahnimw kan me mi nan patapaten: Olon, Sahsa, Mepad,
Dipon, Nepo, Ped Dipladaim,
Kiriadaim, Pedkamul, Pedmeon,
Keriod, oh Posra. Kadeik leledohngehr nan kahnimw koaros en Mohap, kahnimw keren oh doh kan.
Kehlail en Mohap ohlahr; eh manaman sohralahr. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.”
Mohap pahn Aktikitikla
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail kasakawihala Mohap, pwehki eh kahngohdiong ie. Mohap pahn tapwurseli nan pein eh mwus, oh aramas akan pahn kouruhrki.
Mohap, ke tamanda duwen omw kouruhrki mehn Israel ko? Kumwail wiakauweirailla likamwete re lohdi pahn pwihn loallap ehu.

Kumwail kan me kin kousoan Mohap, kumwail mweselsang nan amwail kahnimw kan! Kumwail kohwei oh kousoanla ni aul kan de kisin wasa patapat kan ni pengepengen nahna kan! Kumwail en duwehla mwuroi men me kin wiahda pese ni keilen wahu kan.
Mohap me inenen pohnmwahso! I rongehr duwen pohnmwahso, aklapalap, oh akuh en aramas akan, duwen ar kin mwohnkihte pein irail.
Ngehi, KAUN-O, mwahngih duwen ar aklapalap. Ar lokaiahn suwei kan sohte katepe, oh mehkan me re pahn wia sohte pahn poatopoat kohkohla.
Eri, I pahn sengisengki aramas koaros nan Mohap oh nan Kir Eres.

I pahn sengisengki mehn Sipma, laudsang mehn Saser. Kahnimw en Sipma, ke rasehng tuhkehn wain pwoat me rah kan daulihala Sehd Weitahtao oh pil lellahng Saser. Ahpw met omw wahnsahpw akan oh omw wahn wain kan en ahnsoun karakar ohlahr.
Nsenamwahu oh peren pehdsangehr nan sahpw pwelmwahu en Mohap. I katokedier pwilipwilahn wain sang ni wasahn tiak wain kan; solahr me kin wiahda wain oh kadekedengki eh peren.
“Mehn Espon oh Eleale weriwer, oh ngilen ar weriwer peipeilahng Sahas; mehn Soar pil iang rong, oh e pil lellahng Oranaim oh Eklad Silisia. Piletik en Nimrin pil madadahr.
I pahn katokihedi en mehn Mohap ar kin wia meirong isihs ni ar wasahn kaudok oh ar meirong ong ar koht kan. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.
“Eri, mohngiongi pahtouki Mohap oh mehn Kir Eres, rasehng aramas emen eh kin kesekesengki koulen kedepwidepw, pwehki mehkoaros me re ahneki sohralahr.
Irail koaros sehkasangehr pitenmoangarail kan oh koakoahsangehr ar alis kan. Re kalipwelipwedahr pehrail kan, oh aramas koaros pwuhriongehr nan likoun nsensuwed.
Pohn pwelengen ihmw koaros en Mohap oh ni wasahn tuhpene en aramas akan sohte mehkot mie pwe mwahieite oh nsensuwed, pwehki ei kauwelahr Mohap rasehng sah ehu me solahr aramas anahne.
Mohap mwerpesengier! Kumwail weriwer! Mohap sarohdier. E ohlahr, oh wehi koaros me karanih wie kokouruhrki. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.”
Mohap Sohte kak Pitla
KAUN-O ketin inoukidahr me wehi ehu pahn kohdi pohn Mohap rasehng ikel men me eh pehnpihr kan ngampeseng,
oh kahnimw kan oh kelen mahwen kan pahn lohdi. Ni rahno sounpei kan en Mohap pahn masepwehkada rasehng lih emen me medek en neitik lelehr.
Mohap pahn ohla oh sohla wia wehi ehu, pwehki eh kahngohdiong ie.
Mehkot kamasepwehk, pwoahr, oh lidip awiawiher mehn Mohap. KAUN-O me mahmahsen.

Mehmen me song en tangasang me kamasepwehko pahn pwupwudiong nan pwoahr kan, oh mehmen pahn doudahsang nan pwoahr kan pahn lohdi nan lidip kan, pwehki KAUN-O ketin koasoanedier ahnsoun kamwomwmwomwlahn Mohap.

Me sopohsangehr apwal akan repen mourlahngehr nan Espon, kahnimw me Nanmwarki Sihon kaundahr mahs, ahpw kahnimwo wie lullul. Kisiniei isikalahr irepen sahpw akan oh pohn kumwen nahna kan en aramas en Mohap kan me kin mouren mahwen.
Poakehla mehn Mohap kan! Aramas akan me kin pwongih Kemos mwomwlahr, oh neirail serepein oh pwutak kan selidier oh wisiksangehr.
Ahpw ni rahn akan me pahn kohdo KAUN-O pahn ketin pwurehng kapaiada Mohap. Iei ih mepwukat me KAUN-O ketin mahsanih me pahn wiawihong Mohap.
